Bulgarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian клие́нт (klijént) and German Klient, from Latin cliēns.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [kliˈɛnt]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɛnt
  • Syllabification(key): кли‧ент

Noun

[edit]

клие́нт • (kliént) m

  1. client
  2. customer

[edit]
  • “клиент”, in Речник на българския език [Dictionary of the Bulgarian Language] (in Bulgarian), Sofia: Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, 2014

Borrowed from Russian клие́нт (klijént), from German Klient, from Latin cliens.

Russian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from German Klient.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [klʲɪˈjent]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

клие́нт • (klijént) m anim (genitive клие́нта, nominative plural клие́нты, genitive plural клие́нтов, relational adjective клие́нтский)

  1. client, customer
  2. (criminal slang) target of a killing, target of extortion
    • 1997, Tequilajazzz, “Пистолет [Pistolet]”, in Вирус‎[1]:
      Опя́ть рабо́та. Два вы́стрела и рво́та. Ну како́й ты там по счё́ту клие́нт?
      Opjátʹ rabóta. Dva výstrela i rvóta. Nu kakój ty tam po sčótu klijént?
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)
